faq.title: Questions sellers ask us
faq.support: Still unsure? Talk to us on WhatsApp or call 09XXX-XXXXXX, 9 AM – 10 PM.

card.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
card.a: No. The Free plan needs no card. Upgrade any time with bKash, Nagad or card — you only pay when you are ready.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain like rahimfashion.com?
domain.a: Yes, on Starter and above. Connect it in a few minutes; HTTPS is free and automatic.

providers.q: Which couriers and payment methods are supported?
providers.a: Pathao, RedX, Steadfast, Paperfly and more. Payments: COD, bKash, Nagad, Rocket, cards via SSLCOMMERZ, and SecurePay.

fees.q: Is there a fee per order?
fees.a: Each plan has a small per-order fee by product type. See Pricing for the exact rates.

bangla.a: Yes. Your store, invoices and SMS can be in Bangla, English or both.
